blocks.text: I would be completely remiss if I did not dedicate a piece to the absolute sonic powerhouse that is the 90s-infused soundtrack of ‘Street Fighter’ (2026). Beyond the fact that this cinematic outing functions as a literal, faithful translation of the classic, early iterations of the video game franchise, the tracks selected to accompany the action are impeccable. Every single song choice works in perfect tandem to drastically enhance the overall moviegoing experience. It serves as a powerful, head-banging reminder to everyone that the 1990s did not merely birth legendary, era-defining fighting games—the music of that golden decade was just as […]...
